examples.en: Teachers inform me that Todd's behaviour has improved no end.
examples.zh: 老师们告诉我托德的行为改善了许多。

examples.en: "You have to come to Todd's graduation party."—"I'd be delighted."
examples.zh: “你一定要来参加托德的毕业派对。”——“非常乐意。”

examples.en: Todd's reaction was better than I did - I was much more frightened.
examples.zh: 但托德的反应比我好——我非常害怕。
